description: This file defines a mock class for the IStorageManager interface used in testing. It utilizes Google Mock to create mock methods for storage management operations such as CreateStorage, GetStorage, DeleteStorage, etc. The file includes licensing information and references to external interfaces.

classes.name: StorageManagerMock
classes.description: A Google Mock class implementing the IStorageManager interface for testing purposes, providing mock methods for storage operations.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Mock method for creating storage, returns a result code and outputs the storage path and error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Mock method for retrieving storage information, outputs path, size, and used space.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Mock method for deleting storage, outputs error reason if any.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Mock method to clear storage for a specific app.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Mock method to clear all storages except specified exemptions.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Mock method to increase reference count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Mock method to decrease reference count.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mock method to query for interface support.

calls: MOCK_METHOD(Core::hresult, CreateStorage, (const string& appId, const uint32_t& size, string& path, string& errorReason), (override))
MOCK_METHOD(Core::hresult, GetStorage, (const string& appId, const int32_t& userId, const int32_t& groupId, string& path, uint32_t& size, uint32_t& used), (override))
MOCK_METHOD(Core::hresult, DeleteStorage, (const string& appId, string& errorReason), (override))
MOCK_METHOD(Core::hresult, Clear, (const string& appId, string& errorReason), (override))
MOCK_METHOD(Core::hresult, ClearAll, (const string& exemptionAppIds, string& errorReason), (override))
